errors.text_span: Die y-Achse stellt die Fiskalquote und die Schuldenquote dar
errors.evidence: The y-axes represent the IWF Fiskalindex (left axis) and Schuldenquote (right axis), not a combined Fiskalquote and Schuldenquote on a single axis.
The description does not state that the figure consists of two line plots comparing the IWF Fiskalindex with Schuldenquote for Gesamtstaat (left) and Zentralstaat (right).

The description omits the specific axis ranges for the right plot (IWF Fiskalindex: -5 to 2, Schuldenquote: 30 to 70) and does not clarify that there are separate y-axes for Fiskalindex and Schuldenquote.
The description fails to mention the red line (Schuldenquote) in both plots and its continuous increase. It also omits the distinction between the two plots (Gesamtstaat vs. Zentralstaat).
The figure contains no lilac or dashed line. This is a hallucination.
The term 'wiederaufwärmt' (warms up again) introduces an unwarranted interpretation of the data trend.
